Deadlines & alerts

OpenRouter calculates deadlines and work estimates. From midnight through 04:59, tomorrow/tmr/tmrw means today; from 05:00 it means the next day. Deadlines use your system’s local time. Dates without a time end at 23:59:59; Bare event mentions of tomorrow assume noon; by tomorrow means 23:59:59. “by next week” means Monday at 00:00.

OpenRouter

Free models only, with a $0 price ceiling. Requests use your OpenRouter free-model quota. If the quota is exhausted, analysis stops.

AI runs only when a new task is confirmed, an edited task title is confirmed, or Update AI is clicked in the notes editor. Confirm new tasks and title edits with Enter. Switching windows or leaving an input keeps the draft and never calls AI. Editing notes or connecting OpenRouter never calls AI automatically. Task text is sent to OpenRouter when connected. The connection stays on this device until disconnected. It is saved in this browser.

Tasks become urgent when time left ≤ 12 hours + estimated work time. Alerts fire when time left ≤ the estimate.

Notifications

Subscribe to the same topic in ntfy. Server reminders continue while the app and your devices are off. Farther deadlines are queued by the server as they approach. Browser notifications need the app open.
